name: ai-orchestration
description: The protocol-agnostic Architect/Executor orchestration and task-pipeline framework — works for both Single-Framework Native setups (Kilo-only or Claude-only with parallel native worktrees/subagents) and Multi-Framework MCP delegation, covering task discovery, specification, isolation, delegation, monitoring, cross-verification, and a headless-worker behavioral contract

plugins.name: architect-side
plugins.description: Orchestration workflow (6 phases), task-pipeline authoring (task-pipeline), orchestration metrics & ROI analysis, conflict resolution, task-spec authoring, and manual task-worktree-ops mechanics — works for both Single-Framework Native (parallel native worktrees/subagents) and Multi-Framework MCP delegation. Install if you're the orchestrating AI.

plugins.name: executor-side
plugins.description: The executor-contract behavioral contract - zero interactivity, focus_files, mandatory Final Report, fail fast. Install if you're the agent executing background work delegated by an orchestrating Architect AI.

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: orchestration-setup - maps the kit's abstract role profiles to whatever models/hosts you actually have, configures orchestration.toml, and renders project AGENTS.md. Useful regardless of which side you install.
